purpose: Post-hoc diagnostic localization of cellwise reconstruction error using only archived P-001 frames; this is not candidate ranking, tuning, holdout evaluation, or general validation.

truth_evaluator_only.center_height: maximum material height of truth.faces at the cell center, plus server.geometry.base only for line segments and projection checks
truth_evaluator_only.transition_rule: cell center is within one cell width of a projected truth-face boundary edge, or a shared projected edge whose adjacent non-degenerate face normals are non-coplanar
truth_evaluator_only.coplanar_diagonal_rule: shared triangulation edges with parallel face normals and coplanar planes are excluded
truth_evaluator_only.beam_shadow_rule: potential geometric beam blockage: segment from capture origin to true cell-center target intersects the closed physical beam AABB strictly before the target; all_views and any_view are recorded
truth_evaluator_only.beam_scope: beam masks are false in scenes where obstacle=0
truth_evaluator_only.beam_limit: does not raycast the rest of the true mesh, so it is not total line-of-sight or self-occlusion
truth_evaluator_only.fov_rule: ideal continuous pinhole projection uses abs(local_x/-local_z) and abs(local_y/-local_z) <= tan(22.5 degrees); discrete zone-center span separately uses 0.875*tan(22.5 degrees)
truth_evaluator_only.fov_limit: projection-only model; ignores occlusion, finite zone response, histograms, distortion, and physical detection probability

cell_diagnostics: estimated height and exact truth volume/mean height
signed residual and absolute spatial cell error
per-view triangle contributors with triangle indices, contributed height, maximum 3D edge, and projected XY area
per-view mean contributor maximum edge quality
accepted usable return count landing in the cell
available-view count and pre-fusion cross-view height range and population standard deviation
TIN support, continuous ideal FoV, discrete zone-center span, potential beam blockage, planar/transition labels

domains.own: cells supported by the evaluated method
domains.common_fixed3_aimed: intersection of fixed3_median and aimed_median support in the same scene
domains.whole_box: all 400 cells; volume error is eligible only when all cells are supported and total_selection.selected is true
domains.unsupported: reported separately as area and exact truth volume; never imputed as zero

metrics.signed_volume_error_m3: sum(estimated_cell_volume_m3 - exact_truth_cell_volume_m3) over supported cells in domain
metrics.integrated_absolute_cell_error_m3: sum(abs(estimated_cell_volume_m3 - exact_truth_cell_volume_m3)) over supported cells in domain
metrics.normalization: signed and integrated absolute errors are divided by exact truth volume when nonzero
metrics.falsifiable_concentration: for each method/domain, compare transition_or_shadow versus remaining using integrated absolute error per supported area; support is favorable only when the former exceeds the latter; also disclose error, area, and truth fractions
metrics.aggregation: report scenes individually and descriptive pooled totals by correlated shape family and beam/dropout condition; do not treat scenes as independent physical replications

interpretation_limits: All scenes and frames are reused development artifacts from P-001.
This diagnostic cannot establish holdout performance, generalization, hardware accuracy, or causal dominance.
Potential beam blockage is not full scene visibility; ideal FoV membership is not a return or support guarantee.
Attribution variants are descriptive controls and cannot select kappa, median convention, acquisition, or a new candidate.
